---
title: "My PhD for Everyone"
---

I started my PhD in the summer of 2020, during COVID, when my eldest daughter started 2nd grade.

I finished my PhD in the summer of 2025, when she finished Elementary School.

It then occurred to me that she would have no idea what I did for the last 5 years.

So I decided to write a series of short posts about my PhD for her without university-level math and statistics, using as little jargon, code and formulas as possible.

Then I was reminded that my daughter's hatred towards school and math in particular is second to none, that kids don't always connect with their parents' interests, and that that is fine.

So this is my PhD for everyone.

Note that you can always just read the thesis [here](../index.qmd), if you like.

However, if you are like my daughter, and you start yawning even at the title "Random Effects in Deep Neural Networks" (what?), then you better start with [what is a model](introduction.qmd).
